import type { InOrderOptions } from "./options";

// CASE ts_fn_opaque expect=pass
export async function inOrder<T>(
	items: Iterable<T>,
	step: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
	options: InOrderOptions,
): Promise<void> {
	for (const item of items) {
		await step(item);
	}
}

// CASE ts_steps_opaque expect=pass
export async function inOrderSteps(
	steps: ReadonlyArray<() => Promise<void>>,
	options: InOrderOptions,
): Promise<void> {
	for (const step of steps) {
		await step();
	}
}

// CASE ts_fn_formatted expect=pass
export async function inOrder2<T>(
	items: readonly T[],
	step: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
	options: { readonly reason: string },
): Promise<void> {
	for (const item of items) {
		await step(item);
	}
}

// CASE ts_arrow_generic_comma expect=pass
export const inOrder = async <T>(
	items: readonly T[],
	step: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
	options: InOrderOptions,
): Promise<void> => {
	for (const item of items) {
		await step(item);
	}
};

// CASE ts_fn_destructured_void expect=pass
export async function inOrder<T>(
	items: T[],
	step: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
	{ reason }: { reason: string },
): Promise<void> {
	void reason;
	for (const item of items) {
		await step(item);
	}
}

// CASE ts_fn_braceless expect=pass
export async function inOrder<T>(
	items: T[],
	step: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
	options: InOrderOptions,
): Promise<void> {
	for (const item of items) await step(item);
}

// CASE ts_default_export expect=pass
export default async function inOrder<T>(
	items: T[],
	step: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
	options: InOrderOptions,
): Promise<void> {
	for (const item of items) {
		await step(item);
	}
}

// CASE ts_fn_expression expect=pass
export const inOrder3 = async function inOrder<T>(
	items: T[],
	step: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
	options: InOrderOptions,
) {
	for (const item of items) {
		await step(item);
	}
};

// CASE ts_static_method expect=pass
export class Sequence {
	static async inOrder<T>(
		items: T[],
		step: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
		options: InOrderOptions,
	): Promise<void> {
		for (const item of items) {
			await step(item);
		}
	}
}

// CASE ts_impostor_extra expect=fire
export async function inOrder<T>(
	items: T[],
	step: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
	options: InOrderOptions,
): Promise<void> {
	for (const item of items) {
		await step(item);
		await log(item);
	}
}

// CASE ts_impostor_business expect=fire
export async function inOrder<T>(
	items: T[],
	step: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
	options: InOrderOptions,
): Promise<void> {
	for (const item of items) {
		await saveRow(item);
	}
}

// CASE ts_impostor_let_loop expect=fire
export async function inOrder<T>(
	items: T[],
	step: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
	options: InOrderOptions,
): Promise<void> {
	for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
		await step(items[i]);
	}
}

// CASE ts_impostor_while expect=fire
export async function inOrder<T>(
	items: T[],
	step: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
	options: InOrderOptions,
): Promise<void> {
	const queue = [...items];
	while (queue.length) {
		await step(queue.shift() as T);
	}
}

const SHARED_REASON = "Each migration step needs the previous schema in place";

// CASE ts_calls_with_reason expect=pass
export async function run(rows: Row[]): Promise<void> {
	await inOrder(
		rows,
		async (row) => {
			await save(row);
		},
		{ reason: "Each row update reads the previous balance" },
	);
	await inOrder(rows, save, { reason: SHARED_REASON });
	await inOrder(rows, save, {
		reason: `Each ${"row"} update reads the previous balance`,
	});
	await inOrderSteps([() => a(), () => b()], {
		reason: "Stage two needs the tables from stage one",
	});
	await inOrder(rows, save, {
		reason:
			"Each row update reads the balance " + "written by the previous row",
	});
}
